verified_claims.text: 作者將 GraphRAG 總結為結合知識圖譜生成與 query-focused summarization（QFS）的 RAG 方法，用以支援人們理解完整文本語料庫。
verified_claims.evidence_text:
We have presented GraphRAG, a RAG approach that combines knowledge graph generation and
query-focused summarization (QFS) to support human sensemaking over entire text corpora.

verified_claims.text: 初步評估顯示，GraphRAG 相較向量 RAG 基線，回答的 comprehensiveness 與 diversity 有顯著改善；相較採用 map-reduce 來源文本摘要的全局但無圖方法，其表現也較有利。
verified_claims.evidence_text:
Initial
evaluations show substantial improvements over a vector RAG baseline for both the comprehensive-
ness and diversity of answers, as well as favorable comparisons to a global but graph-free approach
using map-reduce source text summarization.

verified_claims.text: 在同一資料集需要大量全局查詢的情境中，實體式圖索引的根層社群摘要可作為優於向量 RAG 的資料索引，並以少量 token 成本達到與其他全局方法具競爭力的表現。
verified_claims.evidence_text:
For situations requiring many global queries over the
same dataset, summaries of root-level communities in the entity-based graph index provide a data
index that is both superior to vector RAG and achieves competitive performance to other global
methods at a fraction of the token cost.
